# hibira_approvals_webhook (Resource)

A webhook endpoint of a [Hibira Approvals](https://hibira.io/approvals) workspace: Hibira posts each new request, decision and expiry to it, signed with the endpoint's `secret` (`Hibira-Signature`). A workspace has up to 5. The API token's owner must be an admin of the workspace; removing an endpoint needs a token with delete access. Import with `<workspace_id>/<webhook id>`; an imported endpoint's `secret` stays empty. Needs pusher-server#898.

**State.** The state holds `secret` in plain text: use an encrypted backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_approvals_webhook" "decisions" {
  workspace_id = hibira_approvals_workspace.ops.id
  url          = "https://ops.example.com/hooks/approvals"
  events       = ["approval.decided", "approval.expired"]
}

# Check the Hibira-Signature header with this secret.
output "approvals_webhook_secret" {
  value     = hibira_approvals_webhook.decisions.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The https URL Hibira posts to.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace's ID (`apw_...`), such as `hibira_approvals_workspace.example.id`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Hibira posts to the endpoint. Defaults to `true`.
- `events` (Set of String) The events to send: `approval.requested`, `approval.decided`, `approval.expired`. Defaults to all.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The endpoint's ID (`wh_...`).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The signing secret, set when the endpoint is made. Check `Hibira-Signature` with it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_approvals_webhook.decisions apw_0123456789abcdef/wh_0123456789abcdef
```
